question.text: In Table 3.1 (Mandatory Criteria for NPO Registration), which of the following is the indicator listed against 'Registration with Income Tax as an NPO'?

explanation.text: The Logic: Table 3.1 explicitly lists 'IT PAN' as the indicator with the detail 'Valid IT PAN' under the Broad Parameter 'Registration with Income Tax as an NPO'. The PAN is the income-tax identifier; TAN is for TDS compliance, GSTIN is for GST, CIN is for companies (relevant only for Section 8 Companies, not trusts/societies). The Trap: Candidates who administer tax may confuse TAN and PAN. GSTIN is irrelevant to NPO income-tax status. CIN is form-specific (only companies have it).
